# `task_failure_triage_notify`

**Wake supervisor failure triage.** Record or reuse the durable incident for a terminal task failure and queue its single supervisor triage notice; replayed failures reuse the same incident.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_failure_triage_notify` |
| Side effect | `create` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
| Defined in | [`src/commands/contracts/builtin.py`](../../../src/commands/contracts/builtin.py) |
| Contract fingerprint | `sha256:fdab7334b0ff16610c3fa0f3637b1ed2570540ffdbe0347f2232ed328a8d206b` |
